subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 6 updates

question: Do the workflow/security owners accept the new SHA-pinned upstream revisions—especially `docker/login-action@abd2ef45e78c5afb21d64d4ca52ee8550d9572c7`—for workflows that receive registry credentials?
rationale: This is a supply-chain trust decision about executing newly pinned third-party action code with repository and registry credentials; source review can confirm the wiring but cannot substitute for owner acceptance of the upstream revisions.

options.title: Accept verified upstream pins
options.body: Confirm the SHA-to-release provenance for all six actions and merge after refreshing the branch and required checks.

options.title: Hold the credentialed action update
options.body: Land only a narrowed follow-up after retaining or separately reviewing the new docker/login-action revision.

options.title: Pause this dependency group
options.body: Close or defer the automated update if the upstream action revisions cannot be accepted under the repository’s supply-chain policy.

recommendation.title: Accept verified upstream pins
recommendation.body: Confirm the SHA-to-release provenance for all six actions and merge after refreshing the branch and required checks.

likelyOwner.reason: No reliable human workflow or security owner could be established from the supplied read-only context.
